    Expecting a delivery?

    Leave my parcel

    Won't be there to sign? We can leave your parcel somewhere safe at the delivery address. Just tell us where via the tracking tool.

      Enter tracking number

    Redirect my parcel

    As long as your parcel hasn’t been loaded into the delivery van, you can redirect it to another address within 75km for $5, or a collection location for $3.

      Redirect my parcel

    Track parcel online

    The best way to check the status of delivery is by using our online tracking tool.
